bend-kit-bytes@0.3.0.0.reason: Encoding returns this release's nominal Bytes type; MyLSM must adapt its {len, buf} representation to bend-kit-bytes@0.3.2.0 at the UTF-8 boundary.

limitations: utf8.decode follows WHATWG replacement semantics and is not suitable for strict storage decoding; validate UTF-8 before calling it.

bend-kit-bytes@0.3.1.0.reason: The published files package imports this nominal Bytes release; files.check.bend and files/bench also pin 0.3.1.0.

io_contract: read.words reads at most 1 MiB in one host call; a short read is progress and zero bytes is EOF.
write.words loops over short writes; errors retain the File and do not roll back an already-written prefix.
C and JavaScript implementations are host effects and remain outside Bend proof guarantees.
MyLSM must preserve its own fsync, rename, directory-fsync, and crash-ordering protocol.
